title: G1b: scorecard reports tokens per accepted goal — by-role and cached/uncached splits per goal, Jev and Planner buckets, failed and superseded tasks included, accepted goals counted by PR
spec:
Depends on G1a (normalised run rows with goal_id). Scout T-0261: scorecard.by_task sums usd, tokens (input + output + cache_read // 10) and wall_s per task; by_goal rolls tasks up by parent into role buckets and adds gate stats and planner_runs usd, but excludes tasks without a parent, Planner transcript tokens (planner_usage.json is pool-wide per day, read by _planner_usage_totals) and Jev question tokens; goals.py builds pr_url from the goal task result with PR_URL_RE (about line 464).
Change scorecard.py:
1. by_goal gains per goal: tokens_by_role (execute, review, spec_review, scout, other), tokens_uncached, tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write, tokens_output, tokens_reasoning, jev_tokens (sum of jev usage rows with that goal_id, split into gate and rank by the caller field), planner_tokens (planner_runs rows with tokens when present, else planner_usage.json day totals apportioned by the goal's share of that day's run rows, documented as an approximation), failed_tokens (rows of tasks whose status is failed or which carry merged_via superseded), total_tokens = sum of the buckets without double counting cache_read. Tasks with no run rows appear with zeros (never silently absent). Old keys and the byte-identical default output stay.
2. scorecard.accepted_goals(): goal tasks whose result carries a pr_url (goals.py PR_URL_RE) or whose status is done with every execute child merged; scorecard.tokens_per_accepted_goal() = sum of total_tokens over accepted goals / count, returned with the count and the list of goal ids; usd_per_accepted_goal alongside.
3. cli.py: scorecard --by goal prints the new columns total_tokens, uncached, cache_read, output, jev, planner and a footer line 'tokens per accepted goal: N over K goals (usd M)'; scorecard --json unchanged in shape apart from the added keys.
4. Tests: tests/test_scorecard.py::test_by_goal_token_buckets (fixture rows for two goals incl. a Codex row, a Jev row, a failed task), ::test_tokens_per_accepted_goal (one accepted by pr_url, one not); tests/test_cli.py::test_scorecard_goal_footer.
acceptance: uv run orchestrator scorecard --by goal on this repo prints the footer with a non-zero tokens per accepted goal
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
